canonical_example.text: No seas tan cortada y ve a saludarle.
canonical_example.translation: Don't be so shy. Go and say hello to him.

canonical_example.translation: Being so timid doesn't help when it comes to making new friends.

canonical_example.translation: Don't drink that milk. It's already curdled.

canonical_example.translation: When I realized he didn't recognized me, I felt very embarrassed.
